product: Recover dropped Unity Catalog volumes with UNDROP VOLUME
tagline: You can now recover a dropped Unity Catalog volume within 7 days.
what_it_does: You can now recover a dropped Unity Catalog volume within 7 days. Find its ID with SHOW VOLUMES DROPPED, then run UNDROP VOLUME WITH ID to restore it with its privileges and tags. Requires Databricks Runtime 19 and above.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: You can now recover a dropped Unity Catalog volume within 7 days. Find its ID with SHOW VOLUMES DROPPED, then run UNDROP VOLUME WITH ID to restore it with its privileges and tags.
key_takeaway: You can now recover a dropped Unity Catalog volume within 7 days.
